items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach/sources, but same knee had PCL sprain and bone bruise last season—scary history.
items.why: Coach Kubiak day-to-day after trim; working hard.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Mayer temporary TE1 if delayed.

items.text: Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Harbaugh; Chargers will monitor how he feels this week before Week 2 availability vs Raiders. Left early after big hit.
items.implication: Practice participation key; slot beneficiaries if out.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious; MRI to confirm, day-to-day, likely would have returned if playoff game. Exploded for 5-150-1 before exit.
items.why: Not serious per sources; coach day-to-day.
items.implication: Good shot Week 2 vs Saints; Bateman/Sarratt if limited.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share); 23-173-1 rush, 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected in KC debut.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities, routes, and targets in debut.
items.opportunity: Nearly exclusive early-down and receiving work; 22% target share.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty tied Bijan for No.1 Util Score (99); 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 156 yds scrimmage +2 TDs. Upgrades to high-end RB1 every-down.
items.why: Elite utilization and efficiency in new scheme/OL.
items.implication: RB1 lock ROS; history supports 23+ PPG at that share.

items.text: Bucky Irving 85 Util Score, 62% snaps, 58% routes, led rushes/short-yardage vs Gainwell; upgrades to mid-range RB2 (Gainwell mid RB4).
items.why: Clear edge over Gainwell in key roles.

items.text: Travis Etienne 58% snaps but only 43% attempts/38% routes in three-way with Kamara out; downgrades to low-end RB2. Check Kamara return.
items.why: Committee despite absence; high play volume inflated.

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.implication: Start all four confidently; ignore others.

items.text: Bucky Irving 8 carries (1 rush TD inside 10), 21 routes, 7 targets (all caught); out-routed Gainwell 21-13, only GL carry, looked extremely healthy. Result overstated but positive.
items.why: Healthy, edge in routes/GL over Gainwell.
items.implication: Mid-RB2 with good CLE matchup next.

items.text: Travis Etienne didn't dominate with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4. Surprised by committee.
items.why: Shared work despite lead back absence.
items.implication: Low-end RB2; Kamara return further dilutes.
items.opportunity: Still led but not workhorse (38% routes).

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets team-high 31% share, 6-69-0; emerged healthy.
items.why: Limited snaps but high route/target efficiency post-injury.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 last night); only 2 targets 7% share but 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (near Worthy 30). Needs volume.
items.why: High routes, low aDOT/targets in return.

items.text: Jets rookie WR Omar Cooper Jr. ankle sprain; MRI positive news, week-to-week, hope return within next four weeks.
items.why: Ankle sprain left early; positive MRI.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks; even after Dylan Sampson (knee) early exit, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.opportunity: Low routes even with backup out.
